field_evidence: Official register proposal identifies one new annexe ancillary living-space structure replacing the existing outbuilding and log store. Proposed Block Plan DWG No. 08 - 00, Proposed Outbuilding Sections DWG No. 06 - 02, Proposed Annexe Floor Plan DWG No. 05 - 03, and Proposed Outbuilding Elevations DWG No. 07 - 00 support the same single distinct planned annexe/outbuilding. Existing structures marked for removal are not counted.
